tagline: The City of Sails — a harbour metropolis spread across 53 volcanic cones, with island vineyards, black-sand surf beaches and Māori heartland culture.
overview: Auckland spreads across a narrow isthmus between two harbours, dotted with 53 extinct volcanic cones that serve as the city's hilltop parks — Maungawhau/Mount Eden's crater rim gives the classic skyline view.

The harbour is the lifestyle: more boats per capita than almost anywhere, ferries to Waiheke Island's vineyards, and black-sand surf at Piha on the wild west coast. The Sky Tower's bungee looms over the Viaduct's restaurant strip.
Speed's late-2024 stream in Auckland drew the biggest crowds of his New Zealand leg — fitting for a city where the All Blacks' Eden Park is a national shrine and the haka echoes at every test.
